sources.entry: ProjectSend - Upload files and assign them to specific clients you create. Give access to those files to your clients. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: ProjectSend is a self-hosted web application for uploading files, assigning them to specific clients, and letting each client download their files from a private page.
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you upload files and choose which clients can see them, with each client signing in to a private area showing only what was shared with them. Clients can search, filter and sort their files, download single files, several as a zip, or whole folders, and leave comments on a file. Admins get resumable uploads, folders, categories and client groups, sharing to one client, a group or publicly with optional expiry or download limits, per-client storage quotas, custom fields, and a full activity and download log. The README also describes roles and permissions for team members, LDAP/social/email sign-in, two-factor authentication, a REST API with scoped tokens, 16 languages, and storage on local disk, S3-compatible storage or Google Cloud Storage. Docker is the recommended install path, with a release-zip install for servers without Docker.
use_cases: send large files to customers with resumable uploads
replace email file attachments and public links
manage client documents and download history
how_to_run: Install Docker Engine with the Compose plugin and add your user to the docker group, then log out and back in
In an empty directory, run: curl -o compose.yaml <URL from README>
Edit the passwords and APP_URL in compose.yaml
Open APP_URL and complete the setup screen, or set ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD in compose.yaml beforehand
Read DOCKER.md before adding real files; see INSTALL.md for a non-Docker install from a release zip
notable: Private per-client file area where clients see only what was shared with them
Resumable uploads that survive dropped connections
Share with one client, a group, or publicly, with expiry dates and download limits
Scoped-token REST API with generated OpenAPI docs
Official hosted version, ProjectSend Cloud, available alongside the free self-hosted core
caveats: Non-Docker install requires a server with nginx, a background worker and cron set up per INSTALL.md
Cloning the repository gives a development copy that needs Composer and npm before it runs
The README mentions a paid ProjectSend Cloud hosted service and commercial licenses for organizations that cannot accept copyleft terms
Migrating from ProjectSend Legacy is an import, not an in-place upgrade, and clients sign in with email now
